items.title: Qualcomm Stock Looks Cheap, But Is The Discount Deserved?
items.summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) trades at about $176 a share, down about 14% over the past three months and up 12.4% over the past twelve. At 20.1 times earnings against an S&P 500 median of 22.9, a profitable chip designer sits below the market. The question is whether that is a good business on sale or a fair price for a business under real pressure.
